classical_problem.statement: For any compact simple gauge group G, construct a nontrivial quantum Yang-Mills theory on R^4 satisfying the official axiomatic existence target and having a positive mass gap. Fix an axiomatic formulation and justify equivalence before claiming the target.
classical_problem.source: Arthur Jaffe and Edward Witten, Quantum Yang-Mills Theory, official Clay problem description; cited source, not freshly literature-verified here.
classical_problem.quantifiers: For every compact simple G, there exists a nontrivial four-dimensional theory and Delta_G>0; no uniform bound across all G is asserted.
classical_problem.chosen_route: Euclidean reflection-positive gauge-invariant correlation construction, declared thermodynamic/continuum limits, and justified physical reconstruction. This route is not itself the official problem statement.

research_hypothesis.statement: A source-generated, witness-sensitive excitation interface may yield a faithful physical excitation detector with a uniform energy-separation inequality stable under the gauge quotient and continuum reconstruction.
research_hypothesis.problem: Positive individual excitation energies and positive finite-cutoff spectra need not imply a positive continuum mass gap.
named_rivals: finite gaps collapse under refinement or volume growth
energy normalization changes the claimed bound
retained coherence distinguishes histories without controlling their energy
the constructed limit is trivial or is not Yang-Mills
research_hypothesis.risky_consequence: An admitted continuum physical form domain satisfies q_H(psi)>=Delta*||(I-P_vac)psi||^2 with one Delta>0; normalized physical states approaching zero energy falsify the proposed separation mechanism.
research_hypothesis.strongest_falsification: Initial exact controls exhibit finite-gap collapse, a blind detector, cancellation between locally positive terms, and physical-unit collapse. These reject naive implications, not the open witnessed-separation hypothesis.
research_hypothesis.disposition: Research strategy only. Witness retention alone is not an energy lower bound.

spectral_contract.carrier: Reconstructed gauge-invariant physical Hilbert space, not the kinematic link space or a history-word space.
spectral_contract.operator: Nonnegative self-adjoint H after vacuum-energy subtraction, or its densely defined closed quadratic form.
spectral_contract.vacuum: P_vac is the declared vacuum-sector projection; ground-state multiplicity and superselection policy must be frozen.
spectral_contract.gap: There exists Delta>0 with q_H(psi)>=Delta*||(I-P_vac)psi||^2 for every psi in the physical form domain.
spectral_contract.detector_route: An optional physical detector D has ||D psi||^2>=c*||(I-P_vac)psi||^2 and q_H(psi)>=epsilon*||D psi||^2, with c,epsilon>0. Then Delta=epsilon*c. Domains, closure and constants require proof; D cannot be chosen circularly from a presumed gap.
spectral_contract.completion: Freeze volume/refinement index, renormalization trajectory, limit order/topology, physical energy scale, maps of states/observables, form-core density, and a justified transfer theorem. No generic spectral convergence theorem is assumed.
spectral_contract.physical_time: The Hamiltonian uses the reconstructed time-translation representation. Workflow steps and path grades are not physical time.

atomic_gap_branch.meaning: Provisional operational reading: a positive minimum energy for non-vacuum physical excitations of an independently specified source. Not an assertion about chemical atoms or a new particle ontology.
atomic_gap_branch.relation_to_Yang_Mills: Separate source-level conjecture. No implication to Yang-Mills without an actual operation-, state-, and energy-compatible bridge.

conjectures.scope: Definition and first bounded test only; fresh official-source verification and axiomatic equivalence are not claimed and remain reconstruction/assembly obligations.
conjectures.statement: Freeze the physical spectral target and distinguish it from the proposed atomic excitation interface.
conjectures.acceptance: Choose G, axioms, vacuum sector, domains, units and quantifier order; identify the official source and the first bounded source test.
conjectures.falsifier: An ontology label, a bare projector or a finite count is substituted for a specified Hamiltonian theory.
conjectures.next_action: Review the official existence/gap target and write the source/domain/unit table before selecting an excitation detector.

conjectures.statement: Reject finite positivity, blind detection and local atomic cost as sufficient conditions for a stable gap.
conjectures.acceptance: Exact rational collapsing-gap, hidden-mode, cancellation and rescaling controls plus a positive detector-bound control.
conjectures.falsifier: A control is claimed to establish continuum Yang-Mills or a family-level gap.
conjectures.scope: Toy-model no-promotion diagnostics only; evidence is generated by the companion checker.

conjectures.statement: Select an independent source for the operational atomic-gap question.
conjectures.acceptance: Supply H or a closed form, physical states, vacuum, admitted operations and collective excitations without inserting a desired gap.
conjectures.falsifier: Elementary acts are assigned a cost but no energy of their composites is defined.

conjectures.scope: Bounded source dictionary and electric norm only; magnetic-vacuum-faithful detection is explicitly not constructed.
conjectures.statement: Type a source witness packet, its physical-state map, continuation and excitation reader.
conjectures.acceptance: Actual source maps and domain-compatible continuations; explicitly distinguish certificate retention from Hilbert norm and energy.
conjectures.falsifier: Equal endpoints or unequal histories are treated as an energy theorem without an energy-compatible map.

conjectures.statement: Test a uniform positive excitation gap on the chosen atomic source.
conjectures.acceptance: A quantitative form inequality on all admitted physical excitations, including collective states, or a normalized low-energy counterfamily.
conjectures.falsifier: Every named atom is positive but a sequence of collective normalized states has energy tending to zero.

conjectures.scope: Finite Hamiltonian/anisotropic heat-kernel regularization with temporal reflection positivity only; source revision is explicit, not a proof of isotropic Wilson equivalence or continuum existence.
conjectures.statement: Construct the frozen finite gauge lattice state and transfer interface.
conjectures.next_action: Descend the actual-vacuum packet with its covariant derivative target and seek a volume comparison sharper than the global ground-density max/min bound. Continuum correlation construction is independently ready but open.
conjectures.acceptance: Specified action, Haar measure, boundary, link ordering, gauge symmetry, reflection positivity and transfer form where justified.
conjectures.falsifier: A small discrete-group surrogate or Monte Carlo fixture is identified with four-dimensional compact-simple-group Yang-Mills.

conjectures.scope: Entire form domain at each finite source graph, including nonfree quotient strata; no common volume-compatible detector constant is claimed.
conjectures.statement: Descend the excitation interface to physical gauge-invariant states.
conjectures.acceptance: Well-defined maps and compatible form domains after gauge/null quotient; identify exactly which distinctions the detector must preserve.
conjectures.falsifier: A gauge-null or representation-only distinction is counted as a physical excitation.

conjectures.statement: Construct a compatible renormalized continuum correlation state.
conjectures.acceptance: Declared volume/spacing trajectory and limit topology, joint positivity, covariance, regularity and nontrivial interacting observables.
conjectures.falsifier: Pointwise or finite-sample convergence substitutes for a joint continuum state, or the limit collapses to a trivial theory.

conjectures.statement: Reconstruct the target physical Hilbert theory and Hamiltonian.
conjectures.acceptance: A justified reconstruction theorem at the actual domain, with vacuum, time translations, closed physical form and equivalence to the frozen Yang-Mills target.
conjectures.falsifier: An unclosed formal generator, unquotiented link space or noninteracting limit is presented as the required physical theory.

conjectures.scope: One constant5/64 on the complete physical form domain uniformly over finite source boxes with0<=lambda/kappa<27/262144. No physical-unit continuum route, weak-coupling extension or infinite-volume state is claimed.
conjectures.rejected_shortcut: Replacing the actual ground density by a function only of individual plaquette traces; connected mixed-loop dependence occurs at order (lambda/kappa)^2.
conjectures.next_action: Retain the source small-r and fixed-kappa quantifiers when testing physical energy/refinement routes. Construct compatible thermodynamic correlations; a volume-uniform finite-source gap alone does not complete either task.
conjectures.statement: Prove quantitative detection of every non-vacuum sector in the required domain.
conjectures.acceptance: A source-derived D and one c>0 bounding physical excitation norm, for a generating/interface-complete family rather than a blind observable subset.
conjectures.falsifier: A normalized low-energy physical sector is invisible to D or the detection constant tends to zero.

conjectures.next_action: The exact source identity has coefficient kappa. Supply a physical energy conversion and refinement trajectory keeping the converted coefficient positive; the present electric-dominant source window does not cover the weak-coupling continuum route.
conjectures.statement: Bound energy below by the detected excitation, including sharing, cancellation and delocalization.
conjectures.acceptance: A form-domain inequality q_H>=epsilon*||D psi||^2 with one positive epsilon in fixed physical units along the declared route.
conjectures.falsifier: Local positive contributions cancel on collective states or the physical-unit conversion collapses the bound.

conjectures.statement: Test whether the atomic mechanism actually represents the gauge-theory source.
conjectures.acceptance: State, operation, vacuum, norm and energy-compatible maps with a transfer theorem at the required domain, or an explicit rejection.
conjectures.falsifier: A gap on an unrelated finite source is imported into Yang-Mills through matching counts or terminology.
conjectures.role: Optional proposed mechanism; not a prerequisite of the independent Yang-Mills proof route.

conjectures.statement: Transport the quantitative bound through the actual continuum construction.
conjectures.acceptance: Explicit state/form comparison, density/core or justified convergence theorem and one positive Delta on the reconstructed physical form domain.
conjectures.falsifier: Every cutoff is gapped while the reconstructed non-vacuum spectrum accumulates at zero.

conjectures.statement: Review the common-source existence and gap assembly against the official target.
conjectures.acceptance: One nontrivial reconstructed Yang-Mills witness with its positive spectral bound, all required domains and an independent target-scope review.
conjectures.falsifier: Separately successful certificates refer to different sources, scales or vacua, or unresolved premises are treated as a proof.

revision_policy: A changed source, gauge group target, energy units, vacuum, detector or limit policy requires a recorded successor and retained failed candidates. Reference availability is not witness availability.
